name: Don't Be Dumb
description: AI-generated coding drills for developers who refuse to let AI make them dumb. Interview-style tasks with real tests, a rot radar of your skills, and a local history so you never get the same drill twice.

backgroundTasks.name: Daily skill-rot check
backgroundTasks.description: A gentle 9:00 reminder if one of your skills hasn't been practiced in a while and you haven't drilled today. Toggle it in the app's Settings.
